RenoiseScriptingTool.Name: MIDILoopBackCreator
RenoiseScriptingTool.Author: Zyurkalov
RenoiseScriptingTool.Description: Automatically creates virtual CoreMIDI loopback ports for instruments whose names end with "-midiext". Each matching instrument gets a dedicated MIDI source and destination pair, allowing Renoise to send MIDI from those instruments to external software by name. Renaming a matched instrument updates the loopback port name accordingly.
